derivation.n_source: count of answerable holdout queries in the sealed dataset: split=holdout, stratum!=no_hit, at least one grade-3 span
derivation.method: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson binomial interval; the floor comparison is exact rational arithmetic on the upper tail at p = 3/4, and rendered endpoints are bisection brackets of width 2^-64

k_interval.method: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson binomial interval; the floor comparison is exact rational arithmetic on the upper tail at p = 3/4, and rendered endpoints are bisection brackets of width 2^-64

k_minus_one_interval.method: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson binomial interval; the floor comparison is exact rational arithmetic on the upper tail at p = 3/4, and rendered endpoints are bisection brackets of width 2^-64

primary_raters.independence_basis: Independent logical primary-A configuration; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per item in an empty Git repository with the exact frozen prompt only; no candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

Independent logical primary-B configuration; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per item in an empty Git repository with the exact frozen prompt only; no candidate implementation or dataset curation participation. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

grader.independence_basis: Independent logical grader; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per frozen packet in an empty Git repository; no primary, implementation or curation role. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.

adjudicator.independence_basis: Independent logical adjudicator; one fresh ephemeral read-only process per necessary disagreement receives only the original frozen prompt before its answer is sealed; no primary, implementation or curation role. Provider exposes no immutable backend snapshot.
